OUR STORY

ঘরের রান্না,
বাঙালির ভালোবাসা।

Khabar Bela is a Bengali cloud-kitchen idea built around the feeling of eating a warm meal at home — rice, dal, bhaja, machh, mangsho and a little sweetness.

Made for Bengalis missing home — and for Bangalore food lovers discovering Bengal.

আজ কী খাবেন?

Choose your thali, order fresh, and enjoy a little taste of Bengal in Bangalore.
